definition: a horse kept ready for one's superior or for times of necessity.
example_en: A horse kept ready was always at hand in the palace.

definition: cow's milk.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂದು ಲೋಟ ಗೋರಸ ಕುಡಿದರೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If you drink a glass of cow's milk in the morning, your health will be good.

definition: an ox; a bull.
example_en: The ox is pulling the yoke.

definition: a dishonest man; a cheat.
example: ಆ ಅಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕ ಜನರ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That dishonest man cheated people of their money.

definition: (dial.) the act or fact of being frightened.
example: ಸಿಂಹವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅದುರು ಬದುರು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the lion, he was overcome with fright.

definition: a colourless, odourless, gaseous element that constitutes about four-fifths of the volume of the atmosphere; nitrogen (symbol: N).
example_en: The proportion of nitrogen in the air is high.

definition: Manmata, the love-god who has lost his body.
example_en: Poets sing the story of the Love-God who lost his body.

definition: that much.
example_en: That much of a harvest has not come this year.

definition: the fact or instance of being untouchable; untouchability; the practice of untouchability.
example_en: The practice of untouchability is now forbidden by law.

definition: any of a large sub-phylum (Vertebrata) of chordate animals, including all mammals, fishes, birds, reptiles, and amphibians, characterised by a segmented spinal column; a vertebrate.
example_en: A fish is a vertebrate animal.

definition: the quality of being brave, valorous; heroism.
example_en: The soldiers protected the fort with their heroism.

definition: a person who spends all his earnings without foresight.
example: ಆ ತೂತುಕೈ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸಿದ್ದೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಒಂದೇ ದಿನ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡಿದ.
example_en: That spendthrift spent all his earnings in a single day.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A bombala tree stood near the pond.

definition: something (as a wheel, an attachment) that turn around or on its own axis.
example_en: The pinwheel began spinning rapidly in the wind.

definition: anything like a round, long pillow or cushion used to lean on; a bolster.
example: ಮಂಚದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಮೃದುವಾದ ಒರಗುಮೂಡೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a soft bolster on the cot.

definition: a kind of folk song.
example_en: At the fair, the folk song called jhaḍiti was popular.

definition: a particular type of roofing tile used on the ridge where two planes of the roof join together.
example_en: They laid the ridge tile where the two slopes of the roof meet.

definition: the area where three fords (in a river) are situated close to each other.
example_en: People had gathered at the place of the three fords to catch fish.

definition: to become seen; to appear; to physically manifest (oneself).
example_en: A deer appeared from the forest.

definition: that which said, uttered, stated; an account; a declaration or assertion.
example_en: This statement is found in the old poem.

definition: thin, easily digested porridge made by cooking rice flour in water or butter-milk; gruel.
example_en: Because of his illness they gave him only gruel.

definition: a stream or river.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದಿಂದ ಇಳಿದ ಪೊಚ್ಚ ಗದ್ದೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಹರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The stream descending from the hill flowed between the fields.

definition: a cracked, harsh voice.
example_en: Everyone was frightened on hearing his cracked, harsh voice.

definition: a set of two machines or slings.
example_en: They have put the set of two machines for sale in the shop.

definition: the gooseberry tree Emblica officinalis of Euphorbiaceae family.
example: ದೊಡ್ಡನೆಲ್ಲಿ ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನಿಂತು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದೆವು.
example_en: We stood under the gooseberry tree and rested.

definition: having many small meshed or perforated openings.
example_en: That curtain, being full of small perforated openings, let air pass through.

definition: the outer corner of the shoulder.
example_en: The wound was near the outer corner of his shoulder.

definition: the act of turning or twisting (oneself).
example: ಅವಳ ದೇಹದ ತಿರಿಪು ನೃತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸೊಬಗು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The twisting of her body added grace to the dance.

definition: to construct a building for public worship; to build a temple.
example_en: The villagers gathered and built a temple in the middle of the village.

definition: a drink made of jaggery (and with lime, elephant apple, etc.).
example_en: The jaggery drink refreshed those tired in the heat.

definition: any mental disease; lack of mental normalcy.
example_en: Prolonged stress brought him mental illness.

definition: a rodent resembling the rat.
example_en: The rodent damages the crop in the field.

definition: hair that is closely tangled together in a dense mass; matted hair.
example_en: Having got soaked in the rain, her matted hair could not be untangled.

definition: the fact of maintaining celibacy throughout one's life, i.e. being unmarried or abstaining completely from sexual activity till death, esp. under a vow.
example_en: He observed lifelong celibacy and became a monk.

definition: too many to count; innumerable; myriad; countless.
example_en: Countless stars twinkled in the sky.

definition: a most dull-witted man.
example_en: He is a most dull-witted man, unable to grasp anything.

definition: an affectionate gift.
example_en: The teacher gave an affectionate gift to the disciple.

definition: that which makes one stumble; an obstacle.
example_en: The stone on the path turned into an obstacle that made him stumble.

definition: a kind of scabies characterised by large eruptions on the skin.
example: ಅವನ ದೇಹದಲ್ಲಿ ದನಗಜ್ಜಿ ಹರಡಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಗುಳ್ಳೆಗಳು ಏಳುತ್ತಿವೆ.
example_en: The large-eruption scabies has spread over his body and big blisters are rising.

definition: a dhōti, worn in a particular manner by tucking up at points.
example_en: He had worn the dhoti neatly, tucked up at the points.

definition: to do, perform (an action etc.) to carry out; to fulfil.
example_en: He carried out his work well.

definition: an eatable made of the meat (flesh of animals), eaten while drinking liquors.
example_en: They had prepared the meat snack deliciously for the feast, to be eaten with drinks.

definition: to close or shut partially.
example_en: He closed the door partially and peeped inside.

definition: the time of (a woman) giving birth to her child.
example_en: They took her to the hospital at the time of childbirth.

definition: suited to its purpose; being in accordance with; appropriate; fitting; apt.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They selected a person fitting for this job.

definition: the festival observed on December 25, celebrating the birth of Jesus Christ.
example_en: The Christians celebrated Christmas with great joy.

definition: (phil.) the act or statement that upholds the right and denies or condemns illusion, delusion or hallucination.
example_en: The statement that upholds the right denies illusion.

definition: a set of teeth.
example_en: Her set of teeth shone when she smiled.

definition: one who lends money against a security deposit; a pawn-broker.
example: ಆ ಅಡಹುಗಾರ ಚಿನ್ನ ಅಡವಿಟ್ಟು ಸಾಲ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: That pawn-broker gave a loan against gold pledged as security.

definition: the plant Daucus carota of Apiaceae family with fernlike leaves, compound umbels of white flowers.
example_en: The farmer grew carrots all over the field.

definition: a small domesticated carnivore, Felis domestica or F. catus, bred in a number of varieties; the cat.
example_en: A cat was sleeping in the corner of the house.

definition: to have furious look at.
example_en: He gave me a furious, glaring look in anger.

definition: the entire military sea force of a nation, including vessels, officers, men, stores, yards, etc; Navy.
example_en: India's navy protects the sea border.

definition: to plunder - a) to take (property) by force; b) to rob or despoil ( a person or place) by force.
example_en: The bandits plundered and took the travelers' property by force.

definition: a bulky piece of unshaped timber; a log.
example_en: A big piece of unshaped log was lying in the yard.

definition: the act, practice or an instance of cheating; deception.
example_en: His deception was soon exposed.

definition: (masc.) a ruler with absolute power and authority, esp. one who exercises it tyrannically; a dictator; a tyrant.
example: ದೇಶದ ಸರ್ವಾಧಿಕಾರಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಅಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನೂ ಕೈಗೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The country's dictator seized all power into his own hands.

definition: he who destroys the world as by fire.
example_en: In the puranas it is said that the destroyer of the world will burn the worlds.

definition: the tree Psidium guajava ( = P. pyriferum) of Myrtaceae family; guava tree.
example_en: The guava tree in the backyard was full of fruits.

definition: a string, thread that lacks strength.
example_en: This weak rope broke very quickly.

definition: a lane or street inside a town.
example_en: There were small houses in the lane inside the town.

definition: a means of earning one's living; occupation; livelihood.
example_en: This is my occupation for livelihood.

definition: any of the throat diseases.
example_en: He got a throat disease and his throat swelled up.

definition: to roll (oneself) on the ground.
example_en: The children rolled themselves on the ground while playing.

definition: a compound of two or more consonants; a conjunct consonant.
example_en: In Kannada, one must write conjunct consonants correctly.

definition: the plant Gymnostachyum febrifugum of Acanthaceae family.
example_en: The Gymnostachyum febrifugum plant has grown in the forest.

definition: the first person or primeval being; Viṣṇu.
example: ಆದ್ಯಂ ಪುರುಷನನ್ನು ಭಕ್ತರು ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂಜಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Devotees worship the primeval being in the form of Vishnu.

definition: odour - a) that characteristic of a substance which makes it perceptible to the sense of smell; b) a smell, whether pleasant or unpleasant; fragrance, stench, etc.
example_en: The stench of the drain reached all the way to the house.

definition: a harsh, unkind behaviour.
example_en: His harsh behaviour drove everyone away.

definition: an outhouse where servants have their food.
example_en: The servants sat in the outhouse and ate their meal.

definition: a naked woman
example_en: The figure of a naked woman was drawn in that painting.

definition: an offspring of a donkey and a horse; a mule.
example_en: They keep a mule in that house.

definition: a deeply distressed, unhappy, miserable or unfortunate condition of being.
example_en: Poverty pushed him into a miserable condition.

definition: a firm, motionless position.
example_en: Hearing that news, he froze in a firm, motionless position.

definition: a timid fellow; a coward.
example_en: That coward runs away at the sight of darkness.

definition: the main entrance in a fort.
example_en: The attackers entered through the fort's main entrance.

definition: gone or come near or toward.
example_en: He came near to the wishes of the teacher.

definition: the habit of scolding, rebuking.
example_en: His habit of scolding is unbearable to the family members.

definition: a secret or underhanded plotting; an intrigue; a plot; conspiracy.
example_en: The enemies' secret conspiracy was exposed.

definition: the place where judges sit in a court-hall.
example_en: The judges sat on the judicial bench and gave the verdict.

definition: the bird Turdus ginginianus.
example: ಸರಕೂಟ ಗೂಡನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಲು ಒಣ ಹುಲ್ಲು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The Turdus ginginianus bird gathered dry grass to build a nest.

definition: to lose earnestness, sincerity; to become insincere.
example_en: He became insincere in his work.

definition: a mustering of one's military force; a gathering of all the troops of the army together.
example_en: Before the battle, the king arranged a mustering of the army.

definition: to find an equal or matching person.
example_en: It is hard to find an equal match for him.

definition: a very hot condition (as scorching sun).
example_en: In the very hot condition of summer, people ran to the shade.

definition: the state of being disappointed or frustrated; disappointment.
example_en: Failing the exam, he fell into disappointment.

definition: a strong thread.
example_en: He tied a strong thread to the kite.

definition: progressing; advancing; having the tendency to prosper.
example: ಆ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಅಭಿಪಾತ ಪ್ರಗತಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That company's advancing progress attracted everyone's attention.

definition: a living in solitude.
example_en: That sage lived in solitude in the forest.

definition: felicity, as the state of the soul that is emancipated from the cycle of births and deaths.
example_en: Saintly men desire the final emancipation of the soul.

definition: to take meal.
example_en: He quickly took his meal and went to work.

definition: young blades of grass, as in a lawn (periodically mowed).
example_en: The young grass in the garden was green.

definition: a vessel with a snout for serving liquid foods.
example_en: She poured the milk into the spouted vessel.

definition: a morally base or wicked mind.
example_en: Out of a wicked mind he told a lie.

definition: the thick, slimy secretion of the mucous membranes in the nose, that moistens and protects them; mucus of the nose.
example_en: Mucus was running from the child's nose due to the cold.

definition: the final or culminating point; the decisive turning point of the action.
example_en: When the struggle reached its decisive turning point, everyone was startled.

definition: a loud uproar, as from a crowd of people; any loud and continued noise.
example_en: The uproar of people at the market was heard from far away.

definition: a large and indefinite part of the surface of the earth; district.
example_en: There was a famine in that district.

definition: iron.
example_en: The blacksmith heated the iron and made a weapon.

definition: a thin mixture of water with cement, lime, etc.
example_en: The mason applied a thin cement mixture over the cracks in the wall.

definition: a culture (as of a bacteria) derived from a previous culture; a sib-culture.
example_en: They grew a sub-culture in the laboratory.

definition: (one's pleasure) to be marred.
example_en: His joy was marred by that sad news.

definition: to float - a) to stay on the surface of a liquid; b) to drift or move slowly or easily on water.
example_en: The leaves were floating on the surface of the pond water.

definition: to hold or seize with the hand.
example_en: He held his friend's hand and consoled him.

definition: a forest goat; a wild goat.
example_en: We saw a wild goat running in the forest.

definition: the daughter of a king; a princess.
example_en: The princess was playing in the palace garden.

definition: the quality of being sharp, keen; sharpness.
example: ಈ ಚಾಕುವಿನ ಅಲಗಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣತೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: This knife's blade has great sharpness.

definition: (pros.) a syllable having the length of three prosodic units.
example: ಕವಿ ಆ ಪದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ತ್ರಿಮಾತ್ರವನ್ನು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: The poet has used the three-unit syllable correctly in that poem.

definition: to make or throw off sparks; to spark.
example_en: As the fire burned, the stove threw off sparks.

definition: name of a folk goddess.
example_en: The fair of the folk goddess Baṭāri was held with great festivity.

definition: a learned person.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಅಂತರ್ವಾಣಿಯ ಮಾತು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಕೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone listened to the words of that learned man of the village.

definition: a person who is apathetic or indifferent.
example: ಜಾಗುಮತಿಯಾದ ಅವನು ಯಾವ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೂ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ತೋರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Being an indifferent person, he showed no interest in any work.

definition: to emit light.
example_en: The stars were emitting light in the sky.

definition: a vegetable, fruit or a combination of both, preserved in vinegar or spicy solution, and served to add taste or as an appetising relish; a pickle.
example_en: Mother made mango pickle.

definition: an acute infectious disease caused by the bacterium Corynebacterium diphtheriae and characterised by weakness, high fever, the formation in the air passages of a tough, membrane-like obstruction to breathing, and the production of a potent neurotoxin; diphtheria.
example: ಗಳಚರ್ಮರೋಗದಿಂದ ಬಳಲಿದ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ವೈದ್ಯರು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಚುಚ್ಚುಮದ್ದು ನೀಡಿದರು.
example_en: The doctors immediately gave an injection to the child suffering from diphtheria.

definition: one whose profession is to grind grains into flours.
example: ಆ ಹಿಟ್ಟುಕಾರ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆಯಿಂದ ಗಿರಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾನ್ಯ ಬೀಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That flour-grinder was grinding grain in the mill since morning.

definition: a disease of the throat (characterised by the burning sensation therein?).
example_en: His throat is burning because of the throat disease.

definition: a variety of sorghum.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಟ್ಟಣಸಾಳಿ ಜೋಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: In this area they mostly grow the paṭṭaṇasāḷi variety of sorghum.

definition: a man who is an expert in employing vedic or mystical hymns for the right use.
example_en: Being an expert in mystical hymns, he cured the patient with a mantra.

definition: a specialist in spiritualism, philosophy or theology.
example_en: Being a specialist in spiritualism, he is revered by everyone.

definition: the state, office or dignity of an emperor; emperorship.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಸಾರ್ವಭೌಮಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳ ಒಳಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಿದನು.
example_en: He used his emperorship for the welfare of his subjects.

definition: (only in comp.) ten.
example_en: In old poetry, 'padir' means ten.

definition: put down in writing; written.
example_en: Since this is a written agreement, it cannot be changed.

definition: a man who can read and write; a literate man.
example: ಆ ಲಿಪಿಜ್ಞ ಹಳೆಯ ತಾಳೆಗರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ ಅರ್ಥೈಸಿದನು.
example_en: That literate man read and interpreted the old palm-leaf manuscripts.

definition: to be understood, comprehended.
example: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತಿನ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪಾಠ ತಲೆವೊಂದಿತು.
example_en: After a while, the lesson was understood by him.

definition: the plant Croton polyandrum of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: The physician used the leaves of the rochani plant for medicine.

definition: any salted, spicy eatable.
example_en: Many kinds of salted spicy snacks are sold in the shop.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A palambe tree had grown tall in the forest.

definition: the Prākřta, one of the old Indic languages used in ancient India.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಗದ ಭಾಷೆಯ ಬಳಕೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The Prākṛta language was used in ancient texts.

definition: the annual bean plant Phaseolus vulgaris of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The farmer had grown french beans in the field.

definition: the plant Trianthema decandra of Aizoaceae family.
example_en: The Trianthema decandra plant had grown at the edge of the field.

definition: food left out after one's meal; leavings in a dining plate.
example: ಊಟದ ನಂತರ ಮಡಗೂೞ್ ಅನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿ ಬಿಸಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: After the meal she picked up the leavings from the plate and threw them away.

definition: the physical frame of a human or an animal; the whole material organism; the body.
example_en: His body is very strong.

definition: something given to show friendship, affection, support, etc.; a present; a gift.
example: ಅವನು ನನಗೆ ಪಸಾಯವಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He gave me a book as a gift.

definition: a falling down suddenly and without much resistence (as the plantain tree that falls at one stroke of a sword).
example: ಖಡ್ಗದ ಒಂದೇ ಹೊಡೆತಕ್ಕೆ ಬಾಳೆಯ ಮರ ಕದಳೀಘಾತವಾಗಿ ಬಿದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: With a single stroke of the sword, the banana tree fell down suddenly.

definition: revered, worshipped by the gods.
example: ಆ ದೇವರು ಅನಿಮಿಷಸೇವ್ಯ ಎಂದು ಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: It is said in the puranas that that god is worshipped by the gods.

definition: a red flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another; a red lightening.
example: ಕೆಮ್ಮಿಂಚು ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಂಚಿ ಮಳೆ ಬರುವ ಸೂಚನೆ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The red lightning flashed in the sky and gave a sign of coming rain.

definition: that is to be thought deeply about , pondered, cogitated.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯ ಚಿಂತನೀಯವಾದುದು ಎಂದು ಗುರುಗಳು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher said this matter is worthy of deep thought.

definition: sand, clay, etc. gradually deposited by moving water, as along a river bed; alluvial soil.
example: ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ನೀರು ಇಳಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನುಸುಲುಮಣ್ಣು ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: After the flood water receded, alluvial soil remained in the field.

definition: a thick mixture of clay, and sometimes sand, with water, that is impervious to water.
example_en: The clayey mire on the tank's bank was deep.

definition: interest earned or accrued on one's capital investment.
example: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನ ಠೇವಣಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ತೊಡುವಡ್ಡಿ ಸಂದಾಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Interest is credited on the bank deposit every month.

definition: one complete movement of a threaded needle through a fabric or material such as to leave behind it a single loop or portion of thread, as in sewing, embroidery; a stitch.
example: ಅವಳು ಬಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ದಳಗೆ ಹಾಕಿ ದಾರವನ್ನು ಎಳೆದಳು.
example_en: She made a stitch in the cloth and pulled the thread.

definition: a low voice.
example_en: The mother sang to the baby in a low voice.

definition: a village dweller; a countryman.
example_en: That villager used to toil in the field every day.

definition: a fat, corpulent man.
example_en: That fat man struggled, unable to climb down the stairs.

definition: a red banner.
example_en: They held a red banner in the procession.

definition: a noun that denotes a cardinal number.

definition: a writing instrument; pen.
example_en: A pen was lying on the table.

definition: freed; liberated; escaped from another's control.
example_en: That slave was finally freed.

definition: an act of correcting or reforming; a correction of errors, faults, etc.
example_en: Several corrections have been made to this bill.

definition: money that a person actually has or transacted with; cash (as opp. to cheque payment).
example: ಚೆಕ್ ಬೇಡ, ಕಯಿರೊಕ್ಕ ಕೊಡಿ ಎಂದು ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The shopkeeper asked for cash, not a cheque.

definition: not relating to the context; not required at present; irrelevant; impertinent.
example_en: His question was irrelevant to this context.

definition: to give and receive reciprocally; interchange.
example_en: The two friends interchanged their books with each other.

definition: the fleshy side of a person or animal between the ribs and the hip; the flank.
example_en: His flank had swollen due to the wound.

definition: a building set apart or consecrated for Christian worship; a church.
example_en: People go to the church for prayer on Sundays.

definition: a man unable to copulate, because of an inability to have an erection; an impotent man.
example_en: That impotent man had the sorrow of not having children.

definition: broken grain or corn; coarse flour of any grain or corn.
example_en: They made flatbread from the coarse flour.

definition: the place from where or time from when something originated.
example: ಈ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯದ ಪರತ್ವವನ್ನು ಇತಿಹಾಸಕಾರರು ಇನ್ನೂ ಶೋಧಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: Historians are still researching the origin of this tradition.

definition: morally wrong; acting with evil intent; wicked; depraved; iniquitous.
example_en: It is better to stay away from that wicked person.

definition: to emit soft, white (pure) light.
example_en: The moon emitted soft, pure light and lit up the whole sky.

definition: a container made of a substance that can resist great heat, for melting, fusing or calcining ores, metals, etc.; a crucible.
example_en: The goldsmith melted the gold in a crucible.

definition: a quarrelsome woman.
example_en: That quarrelsome woman fights with everyone.

definition: to commit suicide.
example_en: Out of shame at his defeat, he committed suicide.

definition: (beauty) to become conspicuous.
example: ಚಂದನ ಲೇಪಿಸಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಳ ಮೈಗೆ ಪೊಗರೇೞ್ದುದು.
example_en: After applying sandal paste, her body's beauty became conspicuous.

definition: the rising sun.
example_en: The rays of the rising sun fell on the leaves.

definition: the fact of being necessary or indispensable; indispensability; necessity.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಹಣದ ಬೇಕು ಬಹಳ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is great necessity of money for this work.

definition: a luminous body falling on the earth's surface during day-time; a meteor.
example: ಆಕಾಶ ವೀಕ್ಷಕರು ಅಪರೂಪದ ಪಗಲುಳ್ಕುವನ್ನು ಕ್ಯಾಮೆರಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆರೆಹಿಡಿದರು.
example_en: The sky-watchers captured the rare daytime meteor on camera.

definition: a container, case or receptacle, usu. rectangular, of wood, metal, etc., and often with a hinged lid or removable cover; a box.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೆಡಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಪಾನ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother had carefully kept the old letters in the box.

definition: a desire; a strong craving.
example: ಆಕೆಗೆ ಹಣದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿಪರೀತ ಲಿಪ್ಸೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: She has an excessive craving for money.

definition: the act of recommending a person or thing as suited to a purpose.
example: ಅವನು ನನ್ನ ಸಿಪಾರಸು ಮಾಡಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಕೊಡಿಸಿದ.
example_en: He gave me a recommendation and got me the job.

definition: a set of hanging drapery for concealing all or part of the stage or set from the view of the audience; a curtain.
example_en: The stage curtain moved slowly.

definition: to become soft, tender.
example_en: The flower became soft and tender in the rainwater.

definition: a sheep-catcher; a wolf.
example_en: The shepherd woke up seeing the wolf come.

definition: to cause to untie, unfasten, unlock.
example_en: He got the knot untied and unfastened the cloth.

definition: consent; agreement; acceptance.
example: ಎಲ್ಲರ ಒಪ್ಪುಗೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಯೋಜನೆ ಜಾರಿಗೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: With everyone's consent, the new plan was implemented.

definition: the twelfth part of a day.
example_en: In the almanac, the day is divided into twelve twelfth-parts.

definition: to offer religious, devotional service to (a deity, venerable person, etc.).
example_en: The devotees offered service to the god.

definition: to sag from weight (esp. in the middle) .
example_en: The rope sagged from the weight of the load.

definition: (mus.) a musical mode in Karnāṭaka system.
example_en: The musician beautifully sang the toṇḍe raga.

definition: the breadth of cloth.
example: ಈ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಪನ್ನಾ ಎಷ್ಟಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದೆ.
example_en: I asked the shopkeeper what the breadth of this cloth is.

definition: a female fox (of Vulpes genera).
example_en: The female fox was in the burrow with her cubs.
